projectionSha256.description: Raw SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the SINGLE projected .cargo/config.toml file the adapter materializes under CC-5. It is a raw artifact digest of a file, not an H identity, and it is NOT rust-v2.configProjectionSha256, which is the 64-hex suffix of H(native.cargo-config-projection.v2, CargoConfigProjectionV2) over this whole record (section 3.3).

x-opensip-digest.artifact: the exact bytes of the single projected .cargo/config.toml file materialized under CC-5

description: The verified-carrier Cargo configuration projection. Its own H domain is native.cargo-config-projection.v2; rust-v2.configProjectionSha256 carries the 64-hex suffix of that identity, and projectionSha256 inside this record is the raw digest of the projected config FILE.
